events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi. This is Maria Alvarez, born 03/14/1968. I've got a bad sore throat. Can you prescribe me some amoxicillin?
Thanks, one moment while I check.
Thanks, Maria. I sent your question to the prescribing team; your reference is Q N, nine eight nine seven, and a clinician will answer.
Okay, then please pass it on to a doctor.
I’ve already sent that question to the Cedar Clinic prescribing team. Your reference is Q N, nine eight nine seven.
